How I price my work

Insurance: I do not bill insurance directly. I can provide a Superbill on request for out-of-network reimbursement. If finances are a barrier, please contact {{EMAIL}} — limited reduced-fee openings are available.

Session logistics & boundaries

Sessions are 50 minutes. I request a 48-hour notice for cancellations; missed appointments without notice are billed at full fee except in documented emergencies. I hold confidentiality within the limits of safety and law. I am not a crisis service: if you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number or visit the nearest emergency room.

Scope: I work with anxiety, trauma, relationships, life transitions, burnout, and grief. If you need medication management or acute crisis intervention, I will help coordinate appropriate referrals.

Payment methods

I accept card and bank transfer. Payment is processed through a secure portal at booking. Receipts and superbills available by request.

Common questions, answered gently

Below are practical notes to help you decide whether we might be a fit. If your question isn’t listed, please email {{EMAIL}}.

Starting questions

How do I know if therapy with you is right for me?
I offer a short diagnostic conversation to clarify needs and goals. We’ll explore safety, immediate concerns, and the kind of container that feels supportive. It’s normal to be unsure — the diagnostic call is precisely for that uncertainty.
What should I expect during the first few sessions?
Early sessions typically focus on assessment, co-creating a plan, and introducing small practices you can try between sessions. I aim for a steady rhythm that balances insight with actionable steps.
Do you provide teletherapy?
Yes. I meet with clients by secure telehealth and in-person when available. We’ll discuss what feels most grounding for you during the intake.
Is therapy confidential?
Yes — within legal and ethical limits (e.g., imminent harm, abuse, court orders). Confidentiality details are provided in our initial paperwork and I’m happy to review them with you.

Support between sessions

I encourage micro-habits that support embodiment and steadiness: short grounding practices, 3-minute journaling, breath checks, and consistent sleep routines. These are not replacements for therapy, but they often accelerate progress.

If you need urgent support between sessions, we’ll discuss a plan together. I do not provide crisis services; for immediate distress, contact emergency services.

Practical info

Fees and packages are listed on the Investment page. I can provide a Superbill for out-of-network reimbursement. Sliding scale is available for a small number of clients.

See rates

Book a diagnostic

A brief intake helps us both decide fit. The diagnostic is reflective and practical — an honest way to begin.

Schedule a diagnostic

Questions clients often ask

How will we measure progress?
We set collaborative goals and periodically review them. Progress is both measurable (reduced panic frequency, improved sleep) and qualitative (feeling steadier, more agency).
What if my needs are outside your scope?
I will be honest about scope. If your needs require medication management, acute inpatient care, or specialized services, I will provide referrals and coordinate transitions with your consent.
How do cancellations work?
I ask for 48 hours notice. Late cancellations may be billed; exceptions are made for emergencies and safety concerns.
Confidentiality & scope: This site is informational. Therapy involves risk and change; no outcomes are guaranteed. For crises, call your local emergency number. Contact: {{PHONE}} • {{EMAIL}}

Home About Focus Method Rates Guides Begin Contact

Begin the first step

I offer a short diagnostic conversation for new clients — a calm 20-minute call to map needs and next steps. If we decide to work together, we’ll co-design a plan aligned with your life.

Please note: this booking form is for scheduling; clinical intake paperwork follows.

See investment details

What the diagnostic looks like

The diagnostic call is a listening conversation: I’ll check in about safety, immediate needs, past therapy, and what change would look like for you. We usually end with a clear next step — single session, short series, or an invitation to a cohort.

Typical flow
  • 10 minutes — present concerns & safety
  • 6 minutes — history & supports
  • 4 minutes — proposed plan and next steps

Micro-practices to try before our call

If it feels helpful, try these brief practices to build grounding: a 3-minute breath practice (inhale 4, exhale 6), a short body scan, or a single-line journaling prompt each evening. These are gentle experiments — not requirements.

Booking & fees at a glance

Diagnostic calls are complimentary or discounted depending on programs. For full session rates and packages, please see the Investment page. I offer limited sliding-scale spaces.

View rates
